why: LANDED 2026-10-27 (phase-515 C8): renamed to `EmbeddedPublisher::publish_serialized`, the transmit word matching the receive side's `take_serialized` (`c:publish_serialized_message`). The old name is kept one release as a deprecated forwarder. PRIOR ROW (divergence): part of the IMPERATIVE Rust API, which coexists with the declarative component model and is the rclrs-shaped one: `NodeHandle` (exported from `nros` and IN THE PRELUDE, behind `rmw-cffi`) hands back concrete entities you hold and call. rclrs's counterpart exists and correlates by concept but not by name, because ours carries the storage strategy in the type -- `Embedded*` means the entity lives in the executor's static table rather than behind an `Arc`, which is the no-allocator constraint made visible in the name. Which one `nros::` leads with is settled: rclrs's shape, with `nros::Node` as the one node type and the component model as the `nros::Component` / `nros::DeclarativeNode` extension on top (phase-483; issue 0784, resolved).
